requirement: Implicit untaken/taken continuation is a defined outcome
notes: There is no else clause, so the false outcome has no line of its own to hit -- it is defined as 'line 6 not reached, execution falls through to line 7.' A provider must treat this as a legitimate, fully-covered false outcome when both inputs are run, not as an uncoverable or ambiguous branch. Line 5 (`if value > 0:`) is now a first-class branch obligation (2026-09-19 schema fix, see pilot/harness/oracle.py), expressing ground truth: true taken iff value_gt_0. No separate if_false branch obligation exists since there is no else line for one to attach to -- the implicit false outcome is already fully captured by line 6's statement obligation being false for value_lte_0.
